statement: The proportion of mothers reporting Medicaid coverage differs between PRAMS Phase 7 and Phase 8.
rationale: This design compares how insurance coverage documentation has changed over time, focusing on the differences in proportions reported by mothers in PRAMS Phase 7 (2012-2015) versus Phase 8 (2016-2021).
prior_art: The SUID manuscript claims C6 and C9 discuss maternal smoking as a risk factor but do not address changes in insurance coverage documentation over time, leaving this question open.
cannot_establish: incidence or risk, only proportions among cases.
